# System.Net.Mail only parses and constructs an address here; the
        # Boolean return cannot introduce SQL text. Model the two-argument
        # overload with a genuine discard, not arbitrary TryCreate methods or
        # named output storage whose provenance would need a write summary.
        # See System.Net.Mail/MailAddress.cs in the .NET reference source.
        if (method == "TryCreate" and len(args) == 2 and "." in raw
                and args[0][0] in (None, "address") and args[1][0] in (None, "result")
                and "_" not in bindings
                and (name.split(".")[0] not in bindings or raw.startswith("global::"))
                and re.fullmatch(r"\s*out\s+_\s*", self.code[args[1][1]:args[1][2]])
                and self.types.resolve(raw.rsplit(".", 1)[0], position) == "System.Net.Mail.MailAddress"):
            return CLEAN
        if any(re.match(r"\s*(?:ref|out)\b", self.code[low:high]) for _, low, high in args):
            self.incomplete(position, "Unresolved ref/out call effects require cross-file analysis")

ubs.old:
# A module that exited 2 is an environment/tooling failure rather than a
# code-quality result; it does not change what the healthy modules found, but
# the run is incomplete either way.
ubs.new:
# A typed coverage limitation is not an environment failure. Keep exit 2,
# partial status and all findings, but do not tell users to repair their tools.
# Only an explicit partial-module coverage code can remove a language from
# the environment list; missing/invalid reports and mixed failures fail closed.
HAS_ANALYSIS_ERROR=0
if need_cmd jq; then
  HAS_ANALYSIS_ERROR="$(printf '%s' "$FAILED_MODULES_JSON" | jq -r 'if length > 0 and all(.[]; .status == "partial" and .module_error == "ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE") then 1 else 0 end' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  actual_env_errors=()
  for L in "${ENV_ERROR_LANGS[@]}"; do
    if ! jq -e '.status == "partial" and .module_error == "ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE"' "$TMPDIR_RUN/$L.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      actual_env_errors+=("$L")
    fi
  done
  ENV_ERROR_LANGS=("${actual_env_errors[@]}")
  HAS_ENV_ERROR=0
  [[ ${#ENV_ERROR_LANGS[@]} -eq 0 ]] || HAS_ENV_ERROR=1
fi
# Other abnormal exits still retain their existing execution-failure identity.

ubs.old: if [[ "${HAS_ENV_ERROR:-0}" -eq 1 ]]; then printf 'module-failed'; else printf 'module-incomplete'; fi
ubs.new:
if [[ "${HAS_ENV_ERROR:-0}" -eq 1 ]]; then printf 'module-failed'
  elif [[ "${HAS_ANALYSIS_ERROR:-0}" -eq 1 ]]; then printf 'analysis-incomplete'
  else printf 'module-incomplete'; fi

ubs.new:
printf 'One or more scanner modules could not run (tooling/dependency problem, not a code-quality failure): %s' "${ENV_ERROR_LANGS[*]}"

ubs.new: jq --arg code "${code:-MODULE_PARTIAL}" --arg msg "$msg" '. + {status:"partial", module_error:$code, message:$msg} + (if $code == "ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE" then {error:"analysis",reason:"analysis-incomplete"} else {} end)' "$json" > "$json.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$json.tmp" "$json"
